DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with psychotic features (Melancholic subtype).

The 7-month history of auditory hallucinations combined with 4 months of severe mood symptoms (sadness, emptiness, insomnia, anorexia, concentration issues) meets the criteria for MDD with psychotic features.
